title: Concept: go.mod replace without a version
description: go.mod declares a `replace` that names a module path but pins no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The replacement resolves to the latest release of the fork, so the code that builds follows the fork's publication rather than the file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The replacement resolves to the latest release of the fork, so the code that builds follows the fork's publication rather than the file.
